known_limitations: Non-held candidate quotes are page-driven: keep the Main Screener open during candidate selection.
A full live window reaches the model with no news stories: stories are thinned before provider status detail (existing behaviour, left as is).
Finviz technicals (change %, relative volume, RSI) carry no observation time and stay BLOCKED; the model saw price and volume only.
Mark-age and cost/slippage policies are unchanged and remain future lanes.
The session label is not holiday-aware.
The Radar investigation screener read returns 500: the secret-leak guard refuses its payload (fail-closed). Not on the Main Screener path; not fixed.
While its window is hidden, the Screener page does not refresh the universe list or session label; window quote subscriptions kept flowing.
